title: Start of the Satya Yuga; birth of Fo-xi
summary: Start of the first of the four Hindu ages, which CFAH equates with the birth of Fo-xi, the first Chinese emperor (Adam).
description: CFAH-3 anchor point AP-24. CFAH-4 identifies Fo-hi with Adam. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-24: Satya Yuga: 4004 B.C."
chronologies.note: Kali Yuga (3104 B.C.) plus 200 + 300 + 400 years: "start of Satya Yuga and birth of Fo-xi".
